registrationStatus: Working-tree scope recorded before implementation; not a committed financial preregistration.
purpose: Give the exact off-policy estimator enough capacity for its full registered domain of 256 episodes and 32 decisions, and replace reliance on the rational size check by a certified worst-case size bound.
addresses: The exact-evaluation capacity part of obligation 10's next action. ope-rational-v2, causal-ope-v8 (which still calls v2), both successor learners and every frozen path stay unchanged; CE-RL-010/011/012/014/018/019 are not retired.
data: Deterministic synthetic binary64 episodes only, including subnormal, largest-finite and full-mantissa values.
algorithm: The arithmetic, admission and publication of ope-rational-v2, token for token, under a new version, a new entry name and a rational size limit of 2^20 bits instead of 8192. A certificate assigns every checked intermediate a multiplier that makes it an integer and a magnitude bound; the reduced denominator divides the multiplier, so both bit lengths are bounded for every admitted batch.
budget: Fixed synthetic oracle, predecessor-agreement, instrumented per-call bound, capacity, limit-control and rejection fixtures; no historical fit, holdout access, hyperparameter search, policy selection or statistical acceptance.
acceptance: Scoped source, size-bound, publication-flow and conformance evidence for the estimator arithmetic only. No unbiasedness, coverage, variance, data-support, profitability, deployment or order authority claim; the published estimate is marked unreliable, the bound is on arithmetic objects and not on time or process memory, and no original38 status change is implied by registration.
